subject.title: [Bug]: acp-agent.js env construction missing settingsManager.getSettings().env — auto-compaction relies on gateway coincidence

question: Should OpenClaw wait for an upstream Claude ACP adapter release, or carry a temporary ACPX-local patch for the missing settings-file environment propagation?
rationale: The defect is in a pinned external runtime dependency, and choosing a maintained local divergence versus upstream-only remediation is an ownership and maintenance decision rather than a mechanical core fix.

options.title: Upstream first
options.body: File or adopt the upstream adapter fix, then bump ACPX once a release contains it; this is the recommended durable path.

options.title: Carry a temporary plugin patch
options.body: Add a narrowly scoped ACPX dependency patch and regression coverage if current users need the behavior before an upstream release is available.

recommendation.title: Upstream first
recommendation.body: File or adopt the upstream adapter fix, then bump ACPX once a release contains it; this is the recommended durable path.

likelyOwner.reason: The exact environment construction and settings contract are in the upstream Claude ACP adapter.
